{{Top}}
{{Quote|Mug of lum for your thoughts, kid?|Han Solo to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Rebel Force: Trapped">''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]''</ref>}}
'''Lum ale''', also known simply as just '''lum''',<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 1">[[Knights of the Old Republic 1|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 1]]</ref><ref name="Knight Errant">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref> was a foaming,<ref name="Rebel Force: Trapped" /> intoxicating [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]],<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref> and was considered a strong ale.<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File 126">{{FactFile|126|FOO 1-4|Galactic Food and Drink}}</ref> It was popular in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], where it was the primary ingredient in drinking competitions termed "[[lumguzzling]]." While an individual felt the common effects of alcohol when drinking lum ale, it was impossible to overdose on it. [[Jacob Nive]] enjoyed drinking it, as did [[Thwim]]<ref name="WDDW">{{StoryCite|story=We Don't Do Weddings: The Band's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>.

When drunk in smaller quantities, the drink was said to taste sweeter and also slightly soapy, though not to an unpleasant degree.

Following the disastrous [[Battle of Gazzari]], the mercenary commander [[Jarrow Rusher]] consumed an entire bottle of lum ale in order to come to terms with the heavy losses sustained by his mercenary group&mdash;[[Rusher's Brigade]]. In order to avoid discussing the refugee "situation" aboard his ship [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']] with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]], Rusher withdrew the room by feigning that he needed to go to the toilet in order to relieve himself. Instead, Rusher took that opportunity to hide in a recreational room.<ref name="Knight Errant" />

Lum ale was a popular drink in the [[Tailfin Cantina]] of [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], at a launch party to mark the maiden journey of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|hover train]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]'' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] fashion designer [[Lynaa]] and a number of other guests staged a lumguzzling contest within the train's [[Decadence nightclub]].<ref name="Gem of Alderaan">{{DoD|The Gem of Alderaan}}</ref>
